title: Add per-row AL performance guidance
summary: New performance guidance documents how to use SetAutoCalcFields for per-row FlowFields and how to avoid cloning records before Modify or Delete in loops, with corrections to the commit checkpoint sample.
key_points: Added two new performance guidance documents with code examples for SetAutoCalcFields usage and avoiding record cloning patterns
Updated commit-checkpoint example to select at most 500 ordered keys into a temporary buffer before processing
Enhanced reviewer retrieval to precisely identify per-row Commit and clone-before-write patterns with exclusions for valid checkpoints
Clarified the scope of clone guidance to require Copy, GetTable, or by-value writing helpers before Modify/Delete operations
Added comprehensive documentation sourcing AL database methods, Query.TopNumberOfRows, SetAutoCalcFields, Record.Copy, and RecordRef.GetTable
